rule: CFBD's games table is the authority for who played and the final score.

Swapped (the play-by-play reaches the official score with home and away exchanged): repaired. The game's scoring plays (offensive touchdowns and made field goals) show whether the team labels or the two score fields are exchanged, and that one is put right; if they can't tell, the teams stay as labeled and the running score is ignored.
Over (a running score above a team's official final): kept. Teams, yards and EPA don't depend on the score fields; plays whose running score is impossible are never counted as garbage time.
Under (the play-by-play stops short of the official score): kept as is.
A play naming a team that isn't one of the game's two teams is dropped.

classes.swapped: the play-by-play reaches the official score with home and away exchanged
classes.over: a running score goes above the team's official final: a bad score field
classes.under: the play-by-play stops short of the official score: plays or scores missing
